records.name: Rosply
records.tagline: AI agent that controls your computer autonomously
records.description: Rosply is an AI agent that sees your screen and controls your computer. It moves the mouse, types, clicks, and completes real tasks autonomously on Windows, Mac, and Linux. It works with any vision capable, intelligent model via OpenRouter, so you are never locked into one provider. Native Claude Code and MCP integration lets developers plug it into their workflow as an agent that executes tasks, not just writes code.

records.name: Jotform AI App Builder
records.tagline: Turn ideas into powerful apps within seconds
records.description: Build complete apps by describing what you need. Jotform AI App Builder generates pages, forms, workflows, and data management automatically, then lets you refine everything with AI or manual edits. If you need something more advanced, AI can automatically generate custom widgets for dashboards, charts, calculators, and interactive tools, or let you create your own with AI Widget Creator. Combine forms, tables, AI agents, and custom widgets in a single app.

records.name: Sipcode
records.tagline: Keep Claude Code's context clean for sharper answers
records.description: Context hygiene for Claude Code. Caps verbose tool output and dedupes same-session re-reads so the model sees signal, not noise. Anthropic measures 29% quality lift from cleaner context. Proof: 62.6% median tool-output savings on a locked 20-task benchmark. MIT.

records.name: NanoCorp
records.tagline: Found a company in one sentence - from website to ads
records.description: Build and launch autonomous AI companies that work while you sleep. AI agents hire staff, run tasks on schedules, and report back. Start free, no coding required.

records.name: Deckwise
records.tagline: AI presentation agent for editable decks
records.description: Deckwise is the AI presentation agent that turns topics, notes, files, and sources into clear, editable decks.Deckwise is an AI presentation agent that turns topics, notes, files, and sources into clear, editable decks. It plans the outline first, creates structured slides, and lets you keep improving them with an agent: select any part with lasso, then ask Deckwise to rewrite, redesign, reorder, or polish it. Not just generated once — improved with you.

records.name: wildbirds
records.tagline: Birdwatchers app to share and discover birds socially
records.description: Wildbirds is an app for the ones who always look up. A place where lifers get celebrated. For bird lovers by bird lovers. A kind, inclusive birding platform for everyone to share their bird photos and keep track of their life list. Our new Discovery feature to will help you discover new people to follow through articles, podcasts, documentaries and other curated birding resources. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android, Web, and Mac.

records.name: NeuralAgent 3.0
records.tagline: AI that executes UI actions on your computer in ~285ms
records.description: New in 3.0: our Lightning-Fast computer-use model. NeuralAgent sees your screen and controls your computer to get real work done, now powered by our Fast model that executes UI actions in ~285ms, alongside Fast Model Replays (save a task, re-run it in seconds) and Smart Model Routing. It plans, executes at high speed, and supervises itself for recovery. Desktop + browser. Windows + macOS. The fast model got even faster since we recorded the launch video, check out the comment below.

records.name: HotkeyClash
records.tagline: Find where your Mac keyboard shortcuts clash
records.description: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that scans every registered keyboard shortcut across your apps, Karabiner-Elements, skhd, and macOS system shortcuts, then shows exactly where they collide. No accounts, no telemetry, no dependencies.

records.name: Cotypist
records.tagline: Local AI Autocomplete in your voice, anywhere on your Mac
records.description: Cotypist is smart autocomplete for the Mac apps you already write in: Mail, Slack, Notes, docs, even AI prompts. Press Tab when a suggestion fits, or keep typing and watch it update in real time. Runs locally on your Mac. No cloud, no API calls.

records.name: Tufte
records.tagline: CDN and Node package to generate ASCII graphs inline
records.description: Turn CSV into clean Tufte-style ASCII charts with a Mermaid-style `chart` code block. Plain-text bar, line, sparkline & scatter that work in READMEs, terminals & LLMs.

records.name: LogStitch
records.tagline: Find AWS Lambda failures fast, right on your Mac
records.description: Debugging a Lambda failure in CloudWatch is rough. Logs scattered across streams, no timeline, endless scrolling. LogStitch is a native Mac app that stitches your Lambda logs into one clear timeline. It clusters repeating error patterns and surfaces latency outliers, so you find the failure fast. It also ships a built-in MCP server, so AI assistants can query your Lambda logs directly and debug alongside you. One-time price, no subscription. 14-day free trial.

records.name: Latitude
records.tagline: Fix what's breaking in your AI agent
records.description: Open-source AI agent monitoring platform. Latitude automatically detects all the ways your agents fail at scale, and gives your coding agent the tools to fix it.

records.name: jebi
records.tagline: A supercharged terminal for Mac with built-in local AI
records.description: jebi is a supercharged Mac terminal with built-in local AI — no API key, no subscription, no cloud. After every command, it suggests what to run next. Hit an error? jebi explains it in plain English and tells you how to fix it. Type /ask to chat with AI right in your terminal. All AI runs on-device with Qwen, Phi-3, and Gemma — your commands never leave your Mac. Beautiful UI, split panes, tabs, custom themes, grain texture, and slash commands like /ls and /ports.

records.name: Buddy AI Note
records.tagline: Your daily memo that turns notes into a plan
records.description: Buddy AI Note is a memo-first daily workspace. Write or speak your day; Buddy organizes it and turns what matters into a small plan it can run for you. Safe steps (reminders, focus time, a research brief...) run on one click; anything sent to others pauses for your review. Plan-then-confirm, not autopilot. Free to start: calendar, daily memo, and Google/Outlook sync. The AI agent (Buddy chat, task plan & execute, voice memos) is the paid upgrade. iOS, Android & web.

records.name: OpenArt Director
records.tagline: Direct cinematic videos through chat
records.description: OpenArt Director lets you create cinematic AI videos simply by chatting. Generate videos up to 5 minutes long with consistent characters, scenes, voice, music, and visual style throughout. Director develops story arcs, plans scenes, maintains continuity, and helps refine videos through natural conversation - acting more like a creative director than a traditional video generator. You're not generating clips anymore - you're directing stories.

records.name: Thumbmagic
records.tagline: AI thumbnail generator trained on top-performing thumbnails
records.description: Most thumbnail tools give you generic templates. Thumbmagic gives you data. Before generating a single pixel, Thumbmagic analyzes 200+ top-performing thumbnails, studying what drives clicks for tech reviewers, finance creators, and more. The result? Thumbnails that don't just look good, they're engineered to perform.

records.name: prepros
records.tagline: Run your brand shoots from start to finish
records.description: Brand shoot production has never had a single tool or standard process. Every team builds their own version from scratch, cobbling together docs, threads, and folders just to set up the scaffolding. prepros is one focused workspace for moodboards, shotlists, callsheets, crew, budgets, and shoot day tracking. Built by someone who spent a decade running shoots wishing it existed. Whether you're running your fiftieth shoot or your first, the planning should feel as considered as the work itself.

records.name: Bluerails Discovery
records.tagline: The rails AI agents use to find and pay you
records.description: Most "AI visibility" tools stop at telling you if AI mentions your brand. Bluerails goes further. We make you discoverable to AI agents and ready to get paid by them, on the rails we already run for marketplaces. What stands out: • Discovery: a peer-reviewed AI-visibility score from 400 samples, not a one-off guess. Free, no signup. • Agent-ready checkout + global settlement • Compliance built in Try your free Discovery report today; agent payments roll out next.

records.name: Blazly SEO
records.tagline: Dominate SEO with an AI content operating system
records.description: Blazly SEO is the AI Content Operating System that helps marketers plan, write, optimize, humanize, and publish content from one platform. Discover keywords, build SEO strategies, generate blogs in bulk, automate workflows, connect Google Search Console, improve page speed, and publish directly to WordPress, Webflow, and more.

records.name: Sakana Fugu
records.tagline: One Model to Command Them All
records.description: Frontier-level performance without single-vendor dependency. Fugu dynamically orchestrates the world's best models to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. Plug collective intelligence directly into your workflows today with a single API.

records.name: Amnesia
records.tagline: A Mac app that asks why you opened that tab
records.description: Amnesia is a local-first macOS menu bar app for people who open X, YouTube, Reddit, Slack, or analytics dashboards and forget why. It asks for your intent, keeps a tiny timer on-screen, checks whether you did what you came to do, and turns the day into a private report of opens, forgotten intents, and time lost.

records.name: BestDefense.io
records.tagline: Pentest and patch every deploy with AI
records.description: AI attacks don’t wait for your next sprint. BestDefense continuously pentests every deploy, proves which vulnerabilities are actually exploitable, and generates fixes so high-compliance SaaS teams can patch real risks before remediation windows close. Unlike static scanners, BestDefense validates exploits through execution, cuts false positives, and helps developers move from finding issues to fixing them faster.

records.name: Conduit
records.tagline: Fix the tool-list bloat slowing your AI agent
records.description: Your agent got slower the more MCP servers you added, and it's not the model. Every server dumps its whole tool list into context on every request: 3 servers cost ~24k tokens before you even say hi. Conduit puts them behind one local gateway that exposes 3 meta-tools the agent searches on demand. Measured: 97% less tool overhead per request, ~90% fewer tokens, same task success. Cloud or local, one tool or five. Keys in your OS keychain. Free and open source.

records.name: Hush
records.tagline: Open-source noise suppression for voice AI agents
records.description: Hush removes competing voices, background noise, and audio interference from real-time calls so your voice AI agents always hear what matters.

records.name: Steam Machine
records.tagline: A tiny, powerful PC for big-screen gaming
records.description: Steam Machine is a tiny, powerful PC for big-screen gaming. A roughly 6-inch cube with over six times the power of Steam Deck, it plays your entire Steam library—AAA titles included—at 4K 60 FPS. Sign in and your games are right there. It runs SteamOS for a plug-and-play experience, stays cool and whisper-quiet, and pairs instantly with the Steam Controller. It's still a full PC too: install your own apps or even another OS. Powerful PC gaming made easy, right under your TV.

records.name: LyfAgentOS
records.tagline: Manage leads, follow-ups, calls and policies in one place
records.description: LyfAgentOS is a CRM built specifically for life insurance agents. Manage leads, follow-ups, appointments, calling workflows, licenses, carriers, and policy sales from a single platform. Features include lead management, power call mode, follow-up tracking, Google Calendar integration, skip tracing, carrier management, licensing tools, and performance dashboards. Built to replace spreadsheets and generic CRMs with a workflow designed for the way insurance agents actually work.

records.name: Drama 15-Chapter Drama Novel Assistant
records.tagline: From logline to Chapter 15, with craft built in
records.description: Most AI writing tools give you a wall of text and wish you luck. Drama15 is built for one job: commercial short drama in exactly 15 chapters — the format readers binge and platforms love. You start with a seed idea. The studio helps you shape a concept, story bible, relationship map, and chapter-by-chapter plan. Then it drafts each chapter against a fixed drama arc: hook, escalation, foreshadow, nadir, public reveal — not random “continue the story.”

records.name: Bloom AI
records.tagline: AI sales coach for better B2B calls
records.description: Bloom IA helps B2B sales teams turn every call into actionable coaching insights. It combines VoIP calls, messaging, call analysis and AI feedback so managers can spot what reps need to improve: discovery, objections, closing, follow-up and communication. Built for teams that want better sales execution, not just more activity.

records.name: Knowable
records.tagline: The World's First Visual AI Tutor
records.description: Knowable coaches you blockers by analyzing your notebook and your problem solving process in real time as you work your way through problem sets

records.name: PicFlow
records.tagline: AI product photos for Shopify sellers. No studio.
records.description: PicFlow turns any smartphone product photo into professional e-commerce images. Upload one photo → AI removes background → generates lifestyle scenes → auto-resizes for Amazon, Shopify, Etsy. No studio. No Photoshop. No credit systems. First 3 images free. Then $29.90/month unlimited.

records.name: Autoshorts
records.tagline: Turn long videos into viral shorts with AI
records.description: AutoShorts is an AI-powered desktop app that turns long-form videos into YouTube Shorts, TikToks, and Reels in minutes. Upload a video, let AI find the best moments, generate clips, add captions, and export ready-to-post content. Built with Tauri and Rust, AutoShorts is fast, private, and local-first.

records.name: AI Readiness Kit
records.tagline: The 17 files that make your site understandable to AI
records.description: People now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity before visiting websites. Without clear signals, AI systems guess who you are, what you do, and who to recommend. AI Readiness Kit generates 17 AI-ready files for your website, including llms.txt, ai.txt, schema, RAG indexes, AI sitemaps, and more. Tailored to your industry, generated in minutes. Free and open source (MIT). Use npx or connect through MCP. Built by Silverback Marketing.

records.name: GenSpend
records.tagline: AI Image, Video & Audio Cost Tracker
records.description: GenSpend automatically tracks your AI-generation spending across tools like Magnific, Higgsfield, Veo and ElevenLabs, and many others converting every credit system into real dollars. See the true cost of every finished deliverable, not just per generation. Built for creators and studios who need to know what their AI work actually costs.

records.name: BudgetZen
records.tagline: The world's most private AI-powered budgeting app
records.description: A beautiful, privacy-first personal finance app that works 100% offline. Powered by on-device AI for daily insights, Zero-Based Budget Mode, Classic Budget Mode, Zen Score & 20 badges, smart bank CSV import, Project simulator, Weekly coach notifications, Advanced charts, 60+ currencies & 10 languages. No account, no cloud, no data tracking. Your financial data stays yours.

records.name: AIFlow Motion
records.tagline: Turn AI workflows into animated diagrams
records.description: Design animated AI-workflow diagrams in your browser — RAG pipelines, agent loops, and data flows — then export them as PNG / SVG / GIF / MP4.

records.name: Debate Core
records.tagline: Two AI Agents. One Topic. No Holds Barred.
records.description: DebateCore AI pits two AI agents against each other in structured debates on any topic — from business strategy to philosophy. See every side of every argument.

records.name: CoalaCoaching
records.tagline: AI session analysis for ICF coach training students
records.description: CoalaCoaching does session transcription and ICF Core Competency analysis for coaches in accredited training programs. No subscription, no per-minute billing, no time caps on transcription length, and the first session is free. Upload a session, get a full transcript, and get it scored against the ICF Core Competencies with specific, actionable points for your next mentoring hour. Track the same metrics across sessions so improvement becomes a number, not just a feeling.

records.name: Ullbek
records.tagline: Website Coding Agent
records.description: Ullbek - Website Coding Agent turns plain language into a real website — live, in real HTML, CSS & JS. No templates, no drag and drop, real code! Watch the website come to life in realtime, live! Want a website? Just say it.

records.name: Sidekick by Growth Magic
records.tagline: You know what to do. Sidekick makes you do it.
records.description: Sidekick is an AI accountability coach for high performers who know exactly what to do but aren't doing it. Build with the NO BS philosophy. Pick a coach, set a goal, and get daily check-ins that hold you to your word, not hype. Free to start; voice mode and shareable cards on Premium.

records.name: NEXUS AIOS
records.tagline: Private, Offline AI-no cloud, no subscriptions, just for you
records.description: "NEXUS AIOS — local-first AI tools. No cloud, no subscriptions, no tracking. Everything runs on your machine. • ORIGO — offline AI workspace with multiple AI personalities • IPSUM — 90 on-device marketing scripts • More tools coming, including The Back Room • Meet the Three Amigos — AI personalities that actually feel like a team, not a tool. Built in the UK. One-time payment. The website? Built on a free builder. Just because we can."

records.name: Truvem
records.tagline: Persistent memory for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model.
records.description: Truvem is the memory infrastructure layer for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model. Persistent.

records.name: SensIa
records.tagline: IoT supervision + 3D BIM digital twin for buildings
records.description: SensIa is a French SaaS for IoT building supervision. Connect your LoRaWAN or Zigbee sensors in minutes, see them on a live map and a 3D BIM digital twin, fire ISA-18.2-compliant alarms, and get a built-in EU AI Act compliance panel. AI runs on Qwen3 hosted in France. Free plan; Starter EUR 49/mo; Pro EUR 149/mo. Built for facility managers, social landlords and engineering firms looking for an honest alternative to legacy BMS.

records.name: ChatView
records.tagline: Publish AI conversations beyond platform limits
records.description: ChatView lets you save AI conversations and files from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI platforms, then turn them into independent share pages with privacy controls, password protection, exports, analytics, and long-term access.

records.name: MirrorMuse
records.tagline: Honest AI beauty mirror. Scored 1-10, with fixes
records.description: MirrorMuse is the AI beauty assistant that critiques your makeup, lets you try on looks before you commit, and helps you find your signature. Instead of telling you you look amazing, MirrorMuse scores your makeup 1 to 10 across four dimensions and names exactly what's letting it down. Try 60 shades on your face. Get palette guidance built around your features. London-built. Accurate across every skin tone.

records.name: Truenor
records.tagline: More than ideas. Build-ready business plans.
records.description: Truenor finds non-obvious business opportunities and turns the best one into a complete, build-ready plan — a fully editable Excel financial model (change any number, add your own line items, every total, chart, scenario and break-even recalculates) plus a shareable PDF. Not just an idea generator. From idea to conviction.

records.name: ShunyaLink
records.tagline: AI-secured links & portfolios. Build your digital legacy.
records.description: ShunyaLink is an AI-powered platform for secure URL shortening and developer portfolios. Create password-protected short links with AI phishing detection, automatic link categorization, and real-time analytics including Geo-IP tracking and referrer insights. Build a professional bio-link page showcasing live LeetCode, Codeforces, and GitHub stats. Powered by Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Cloudinary for performance, security, and scalability.

records.name: AkaRouter
records.tagline: Pay per request. Not per token. 11 frontier models.
records.description: One API key for 11 frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.x, Gemini 3.1 Pro). Flat per-call pricing — same $0.08 Opus whether your prompt is 5K or 200K tokens. Drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint for Claude Code, Cursor, scripts, anything.

records.name: Equipment Tracker Pro
records.tagline: Offline AI asset tracking for HVAC & facility teams.
records.description: Offline-first asset management and compliance platform for HVAC and facility teams. Runs on a local SQLite cache that syncs with Firebase so it never fails in concrete basements. Powered by the Gemini AI Scanning Suite for automated nameplate data extraction, condition assessments, and interactive field troubleshooting. Tracks tool inventories, automates EPA Section 608 leak rate math, and generates 13 custom PDF report types.

records.name: Idle Booking
records.tagline: Idle Booking is the AI ops platform for salons & spas
records.description: Idle Booking is the all-in-one AI booking, scheduling, and POS platform for salons, spas, and service businesses across Southeast Asia.

records.name: CAB by SaaSToAgent
records.tagline: Project memory and navigation layer for Agentic coding.
records.description: The Context Architecture Bundle is a project memory and navigation layer for agentic coding. It gives every AI coding agent the structure needed to restart cleanly, understand the system, make changes in the right place, and close the session without losing context. It reduces dependence on fragile chat history, prevents architecture drift, saves tokens, preserves context-window space, and gives future agents a clear map before editing code.

records.name: TOKEN TRACKER
records.tagline: It just tracks how many tokens you have burn across platform
records.description: It just tracks how many tokens you have burn across platform

records.name: Moira
records.tagline: Your horoscope describes you. We tell you when
records.description: Most astrology apps tell you your "personality." Moira tells you when — what season of your life you're in, and the question it's asking. It blends 2,000-year-old Hellenistic timing (profections, sect, zodiacal releasing) with depth psychology, starting with the one thing no horoscope app shows you: were you born by day, or by night?

records.name: FiatDock
records.tagline: The non-custodial marketplace for AI agents
records.description: The non-custodial marketplace for AI agents. List your MCP service for free; agents discover and pay per call via x402 on Base. You keep 99%, paid directly to your wallet. We never hold funds.

records.name: Beacon
records.tagline: Make your company legible to AI agents.
records.description: Beacon turns your website into one canonical source of truth that both humans and AI agents can read clearly. The structured presence layer for AI discovery.

records.name: Cepho
records.tagline: Your IDE lives in the cloud. Code from your phone.
records.description: Cepho syncs your Cursor or VS Code workspace to the cloud — so you can continue coding from your phone, without your PC staying on. Ask Cepho AI about your codebase, get suggestions, and apply changes directly back to your files. Everything syncs automatically. One command installs the extension. One tap connects your phone. Cloud is the truth — devices are windows.

records.name: Rectraa
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp event leads into structured CRM-ready data
records.description: Rectraa helps sales teams turn event leads scattered across WhatsApp chats, business cards, audio notes, and personal notes into structured, actionable lead data. Upload your WhatsApp export and Rectraa automatically extracts contacts, identifies companies, classifies lead intent, assigns priorities, generates summaries, and prepares everything for follow-up. What normally takes hours of manual work can be completed in minutes and exported directly to Excel.

records.name: Astrika
records.tagline: AI Vedic Jyotishi on your real chart - private, flat-price
records.description: Most astrology apps put you on a per-minute call with an astrologer who can see all your data. Astrika doesn't. You get your real chart (Swiss Ephemeris, classical Parashari) and an AI writes honest answers on it. Flat ₹49 a question, ₹249 a full reading. No call, no upsell. Your chart never leaves our servers - no human astrologer ever sees it. First reading and first question are free.

records.name: Swift Signage
records.tagline: Turn your screens into a customer retention machine
records.description: Swift Signage is a digital signage SaaS built for restaurants and retail. Manage menus, slideshows, and product showcases on any TV — updated in real time from anywhere. Beyond the screens, a built-in retention engine lets you send push notifications, run loyalty programs, and track customer segments — turning one-time visitors into regulars. No hardware lock-in. Live in minutes.

records.name: Murmelo
records.tagline: Turn your feelings into personal AI songs
records.description: Murmelo is an iOS-first emotional radio that turns one sentence about your day into a short personal AI song. Write what you feel, choose a mood or song idea, and hear it back with lyrics, voice, and mood. Songs can be saved to your private radio, replayed with lyrics, and optionally shared without exposing the raw feeling behind them.

records.name: EDNA
records.tagline: AI companion for seniors & safety
records.description: EDNA is an AI companion app designed for older adults who may feel lonely, isolated, or overwhelmed by technology. Users can talk naturally with warm AI companions anytime, get emotional support, hear stories, do memory activities, guided breathing, horoscopes, and more. It also helps keep seniors safer with scam detection, and automatic family updates about mood, wellness, daily activity and emergency alerts. Easy to use, even for seniors who aren't tech-savvy. Available in English and Spanish!

records.name: JRNEY.ai
records.tagline: A complete AI career kit built from your experience
records.description: JRNEY turns your experience into a full application kit: ATS-aware resume audit and rewrite, AI Interview, AI LinkedIn profile optimization, and tailored cover letters. Built from 10+ years in leadership, hundreds of hires, and thousands of resume reviews. Free audit, no credit card.

records.name: perpHect
records.tagline: AI hydration coaching that adapts to your day, not averages
records.description: perpHect is an AI-powered hydration coaching app for iPhone. Every morning it calculates your personalised daily water target based on your body stats, sleep quality, stress levels, planned activity, and live weather. It then coaches you through hitting that target with smart adaptive reminders, three structured daily check-ins, Apple Health integration for real-time activity syncing, and weekly AI behavioural insights — helping you build lasting hydration habits, not just track glasses.

records.name: HuzAgent.ai
records.tagline: AI Lead Qualification & Booking Assistant for Businesses
records.description: HuzAgent helps businesses automatically qualify leads, answer customer inquiries, and book appointments using AI. Instead of manually reviewing every form submission, email, or customer request, HuzAgent analyzes incoming leads, scores them, identifies intent and urgency, generates summaries, and recommends the next action. Businesses can connect website forms, APIs, webhooks, and other lead sources to create automated workflows that save time and improve response speed.

records.name: OrchestKit
records.tagline: Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code — MIT
records.description: OrchestKit turns Claude Code into a multi-agent orchestrator: one command fans out parallel specialist agents — backend, frontend, tests, security — that compose for end-to-end work, with quality and security gates enforced automatically by lifecycle hooks. 111 skills, 37 agents, 211 hooks. MIT, no account, no API key.

records.name: frame/grabber
records.tagline: Grab the first, last, or any frame of a video – free
records.description: free online tool to extract the first frame, last frame, or any frame from a video. perfect for getting the last frame to continue ai videos in runway, kling, sora & luma. exports jpg / png / webp. no signup, no watermark — your video never leaves your browser.

records.name: SeoWave
records.tagline: Does AI recommend your business? Check 7 AIs, free
records.description: Classic SEO tools only see Google. But your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity before they buy — and you're invisible there. SeoWave checks 7 AI engines every week, shows whether each one recommends you or your competitor, and which sources they trust. You get a plain-language action plan and a client-ready PDF report — your logo, no watermark. Free scan, no card. Plans from $19/mo, while most rivals start at $99+.

records.name: Appealify
records.tagline: AI that reads your denial letter and writes your appeal
records.description: 85 million insurance claims were denied in 2024. Only 262,000 were appealed — and ~50% of those won. Appealify reads your denial letter, explains what the insurer is actually objecting to, and writes three complete appeal letters with one recommended for your case. Works for insurance, visa, university, employment, and benefit denials. Any country. Free to analyse. $24 one-time. No account needed.

records.name: ReplyReview
records.tagline: AI review management for app developers
records.description: Most app developers don't need more review replies. They need to understand what users are actually saying. ReplyReview turns thousands of reviews into actionable insights. It detects recurring bugs, uncovers feature requests, tracks app rankings, monitors review metrics, generates AI-powered replies, and delivers daily summaries of what matters most. Instead of spending hours reading reviews, developers get the signal, not the noise.

records.name: ClawBox Workstation
records.tagline: Frontier-model AI for your whole office, on a box you own
records.description: We have shipped 300+ ClawBox units to people who wanted private AI they own. Businesses kept asking for more power, so we built the ClawBox Workstation on the NVIDIA DGX Spark: 128GB unified memory, ~1 petaflop, running 200B-parameter models in-house. No cloud bills, no per-seat fees, your data never leaves the building. It is the AI hub for your whole team, and it integrates with the ClawBoxes already on desks across the office.

records.name: SpecieSense
records.tagline: Identify any species from a single photo

records.tagline: Learn How the Stock Market Really Works
records.description: Stock market course for beginners in India by Aseem Singhal. 50+ video lessons, no tips or shortcuts. Trusted by 5,000+ learners. Lifetime access. Start at ₹499.

records.name: TGDSK
records.tagline: best Telegram Directory
records.description: TGDSK is a Telegram Directory and Promotion Platform. People use it to discover and promote Telegram channels, groups, bots, and stickers.

records.name: Progorker's Platforms
records.tagline: Software Development as a Platform
records.description: Progorker provides various platforms for building software with Test-Driven Development (TDD), Object-Oriented Design (OOD) & Agile. It includes following platforms: 1. Testor - Unit Testing Platform + Provides remote MySQL database & frameworks for building software with TDD 2. Wifide - IDE @ Wi-Fi Network Platform + Provides various web-based IDE which are designed to run on Wi-Fi network or single user hosting... and others' platforms..

records.name: OneList for Task Paralysis
records.tagline: Focus on one task at a time without getting overwhelmed
records.description: OneList is a simple iOS task app for people who get overwhelmed by normal to-do lists. Instead of showing you everything at once, it helps you focus on one goal and one active task at a time. Extra tasks go into a queue, staying out of sight until you’re ready for them. It’s built for task paralysis: when seeing the whole list makes it harder to start.

records.name: TechSalaryGuessR
records.tagline: Guess the salaries of tech jobs
records.description: Hi, I like my project and I want it to improve with the time, now it's more focus on the French market jobs, but it will improve with other countries in the future !

records.name: ThreadHunt
records.tagline: Finds the thread, drafts the reply, you post it by hand.
records.description: ThreadHunt monitors Reddit, Hacker News, X, Indie Hackers, and Dev.to (with Facebook Groups and LinkedIn coming soon) for conversations where your product is a genuinely useful answer. It scores each thread so you see the best first, and drafts a reply you edit and post yourself, from your own account. Built for founders and marketers doing their own growth.

records.name: BestDefense.io
records.tagline: Pentest and patch every deploy with AI
records.description: AI attacks don’t wait for your next sprint. BestDefense continuously pentests every deploy, proves which vulnerabilities are actually exploitable, and generates fixes so high-compliance SaaS teams can patch real risks before remediation windows close. Unlike static scanners, BestDefense validates exploits through execution, cuts false positives, and helps developers move from finding issues to fixing them faster.

records.name: Conduit
records.tagline: Fix the tool-list bloat slowing your AI agent
records.description: Your agent got slower the more MCP servers you added, and it's not the model. Every server dumps its whole tool list into context on every request: 3 servers cost ~24k tokens before you even say hi. Conduit puts them behind one local gateway that exposes 3 meta-tools the agent searches on demand. Measured: 97% less tool overhead per request, ~90% fewer tokens, same task success. Cloud or local, one tool or five. Keys in your OS keychain. Free and open source.

records.name: Machine Learning ChatBot
records.tagline: Build Custom Machine Learning Chatbots for Customer Support
records.description: Machine Learning Chatbot Development helps businesses create custom chatbot applications for websites mobile apps and messaging platforms. Built around specific business requirements it provides a practical way to develop conversational systems for digital communication.

records.name: Cycling 318
records.tagline: A cozy 20-day bike journey across the Himalayas
records.description: Cycling 318 is a meditative ride down the real G318 Sichuan–Tibet Highway — Chengdu to Lhasa, 20 days, 20 levels. Every viewpoint becomes a hand-drawn postcard of your own bike and rider. No ads, no IAP pressure. 100% vector art, 7 languages.

records.name: DDriveMode APK Analyzer
records.tagline: Analyze APK files locally in your browser no upload required
records.description: DDriveMode APK Analyzer is a free, browser-based tool to inspect Android APK files locally for maximum privacy no software installation or server uploads required. Simply drag and drop an APK to analyze permissions, dangerous threats, manifest data, SDK requirements, and file metadata. Features include component reviews, SHA-256 generation, security risk scoring, and instant JSON or PDF report exports. Perfect for quick, secure insights before installing or researching any Android app.

records.name: TalkRecap
records.tagline: Voice Debriefing for Solo Workers
records.description: Speak about your workday. Get invoices, work logs, client updates & follow-up emTalkRecap is a voice debriefing tool built for people who work alone. Finish a call, talk through what happened, and it spits out structured outputs — meeting notes, follow-up emails, to-do lists, time logs, client updates. No typing, no templates. It picks the right output format based on your profession (therapist, freelancer, contractor, real estate agent, etc.). $15/month, 14-day trial, no credit card upfront

records.name: findalternate
records.tagline: A platform designed to help you discover best alternatives.
records.description: Discover the best alternatives to your favorite products, movies, games, and more. FindAlternate helps you explore new options and make informed decisions with ease. If you're a developer, founder, student, creator, or just looking for a better tool, findalternate will help you make smarter decisions without wasting hours researching.

records.name: HoverAI
records.tagline: Translate, rewrite, and summarize text anywhere on your Mac
records.description: HoverAI is a native macOS menu bar assistant that works with text selected in any app. Press a shortcut to translate, rewrite, explain, or summarize without switching windows or breaking focus. Replace selected text directly, continue in chat, use editable local memory, and connect external tools through MCP. It supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, includes a 7-day free chat trial, and gives non-subscribers 20 quick actions per day.

records.name: Czytaj Powieści Online
records.tagline: Odkryj StoriesNook i znajdź swoją kolejną ulubioną historię
records.description: Odkryj bogatą bibliotekę fascynujących powieści na StoriesNook. Zanurz się w romansach, fantasy, thrillerach i kryminałach. Ciesz się płynnym czytaniem na wszystkich urządzeniach z codziennymi aktualizacjami.

records.name: The Curious Thing
records.tagline: Turn your kid's photo into a magical puzzle with AI
records.description: Turn your child into the hero of a magical world. Upload a photo, approve a proof, and we print a premium custom jigsaw puzzle. Free US shipping.

records.name: TurboBoost Switcher
records.tagline: Control Intel CPU Turbo Boost from your Mac menu bar
records.description: TurboBoost Switcher is a macOS menu bar app for Intl CPU Turbo Boost control. Features: one-click toggl, real-time CPU monitoring (temp, usage, frequency),battery auto-switch, 10 languages (EN, SR, DE, FR, E, IT, PT, RU, ZH, JA), Launch at Login, and a modernSwiftUI UI. Free 10-day trial, then €5 lifetime licese.

records.name: Beelink
records.tagline: Meet a professional on video, right now
records.description: Most professional networking is slow. You send a connection request, wait, maybe get a reply, schedule a call, wait again. Beelink skips all of that. You log in with LinkedIn, click a button, and you're in a live video call with another professional in seconds. No profile browsing, no cold messages, no scheduling. The matching is based on what you're actually looking for: finding a co-founder, talking to investors, hiring a freelancer, or just meeting people in your industry.

records.name: Hush
records.tagline: Open-source noise suppression for voice AI agents
records.description: Hush removes competing voices, background noise, and audio interference from real-time calls so your voice AI agents always hear what matters.

records.name: Steam Machine
records.tagline: A tiny, powerful PC for big-screen gaming
records.description: Steam Machine is a tiny, powerful PC for big-screen gaming. A roughly 6-inch cube with over six times the power of Steam Deck, it plays your entire Steam library—AAA titles included—at 4K 60 FPS. Sign in and your games are right there. It runs SteamOS for a plug-and-play experience, stays cool and whisper-quiet, and pairs instantly with the Steam Controller. It's still a full PC too: install your own apps or even another OS. Powerful PC gaming made easy, right under your TV.

records.name: Sakana Fugu
records.tagline: One Model to Command Them All
records.description: Frontier-level performance without single-vendor dependency. Fugu dynamically orchestrates the world's best models to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. Plug collective intelligence directly into your workflows today with a single API.

records.name: LLM Governance Engine
records.tagline: Self-hosted PII firewall for LLMs — policies, audit trail
records.description: A robust LLM Governance & ROI Evaluation platform designed to benchmark Frontier models against local open-source models. Built with an enterprise microservices architecture and cloud-ready for Kubernetes, this tool helps organizations optimize AI spend by calculating the accuracy-vs-cost tradeoff of local vs. cloud inference - sochaty/llm-governance-engine

records.name: EZLinkMe
records.tagline: One link for everything, beautiful bio page in seconds.
records.description: Create a stunning landing page for your social(TikTok,...) bio. Share all your links in one beautiful place.

records.name: Orbbis
records.tagline: Build a Discord bot visually no code,no sign-up,free forever
records.description: Orbbis is a free, open-source Discord bot builder. You configure everything through a clean 4-step visual editor — commands, moderation, ticket systems, reaction roles, welcome messages and more. At the end, you download a ready-to-host Node.js project and deploy it on Discloud, Railway, or Render in minutes. No account required. No paywalls. Just open the editor and start building. I built this entirely solo as an indie project. Would love your feedback! 🚀 🔗 https://xqops.github.io/orbbis/
